title: Bellmont girls basketball celebrates state title with community - NewsBreak
text:
By Kortney Grimm ,
1 hours ago
FORT WAYNE, Ind. (WANE) — It was a night filled with joy at Bellmont High School as the community was invited to celebrate the girls’ basketball state championship win.
Believe in Bellmont! Braves outlasts Roncalli to win 3A state title, 55-46 As the Braves had a historic season, they topped it all off with a 55-46 win over Roncalli on Saturday.
“The first thing I knew to do is just go celebrate with my girls, running over to the bench and just jumping up and down like that was immediately my first reaction to go do,” Lanie French, a junior guard, said. “I think everyone talks about like, this is such a great experience, but it truly is like an ‘I made it’ moment, seeing everyone in the stands and seeing how much our team has accomplished this year.”
The Braves finished this season at 25-3 overall, and this win marks the first girls’ basketball state title in school history.
“It was just an amazing experience,” Marianne Bleke, a sophomore center, said. “I haven’t really felt that before, and it was just awesome to feel. I’m super proud of it. I love that we can support our community, and we get to have a lasting memory that’s going to stay at this school forever.”
At their community celebration on Wednesday, they all got to reflect on all of the memories they made, share stories, and present their new trophy.
“When it got down to the last minute or so, and we’re up about eight, and you sort of take it all in that this is probably going to be a win, it was crazy for me to just try to stay as calm as I could,” Andy Heim, Head Coach, said. “Then to see the girls after the game just sort of understand what they just did and what they just accomplished, that was the best part. Just see them all run to each other and celebrate in tears and all of that, it was an amazing experience.”
The Braves will return all but one player for the 2026-2027 season.
